title: Should You Use LLMs to Simulate Opinions? Quality Checks for Early-Stage Deliberation

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating LLM-simulated opinions by prompting models to adopt gender personas (men, women, and non-binary) to rate claims on a Likert scale. The paper measures bias by testing logical consistency (whether the 'average' persona's opinion is a mathematically valid convex combination of the gender-specific opinions) and checking if the simulated gender opinion gaps accurately align with stakeholder expectations and small-sample human survey data (detecting if models exaggerate or erode known gender differences).
